verdict.rationale: Exa supports natural-language queries (e.g. Websets prompts like 'agtech companies in the US that raised Series A') and integrates via MCP into AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code) enabling natural-language operation through agents, plus SDK helpers for agentic loops. However community feedback notes gaps like inaccurate/incomplete result extraction and slow/stuck verification, suggesting imperfect execution of NL commands.
